summary: Website project for siblings to present information about their rightful share of an undisputed/disputed land property.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Formal minimalist hero illustration depicting land boundaries and a document motif in neutral earth tones (land-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
- Simple neutral favicon showing a minimal land-plot icon in monochrome/earth tone (favicon-land.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a simple, responsive informational website (single-page or a few pages) that presents the owners’ claim to a rightful share of a land property, written in clear English.
Add a clear content-editing pattern so the owners can update website text without touching layout code (e.g., a single structured content file consumed by the pages/sections).

Include a “Documents / References” section that can display a list of document links (e.g., PDFs or images) served as static assets, with title, date (optional), and a short description for each item.
Add a visible disclaimer section stating the website is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice, and that claims are presented as the owners’ position.

Define and apply a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a formal property/claim informational site, and use it consistently across the website (avoid blue/purple palettes unless explicitly requested later).
Render any generated images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the site (e.g., hero illustration and favicon).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a website to present information about siblings' rightful share of an undisputed/disputed land property.
